gnosh trust

  Trust a folder's own settings, list the trusted folders, or forget one. With
  no folder, the current one. --list takes no folder.

  Not built yet in this build of gnosh: typing it stops with a message that
  says so.

Usage
  gnosh trust [flags] [folder]

Flags
  --list
      List the trusted folders. (Not built yet.)
  --forget
      Forget the folder instead of trusting it. (Not built yet.)
  --cwd <dir>
      Work in this folder instead of the current one.
  -h, --help
      Show help: gnosh's, or after a command's name that command's.
